pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Breeding:$() a thin animal puts feed into condition instead of breeding.$(li)$(thing)Milk:$() cows and nannies give milk once a day, and only when not thin.$(li)$(thing)Eggs:$() thin hens stop laying; roosters never lay.

$(li)$(thing)Wool:$() sheep regrow wool by grazing.$(li)$(thing)Manure:$() well-fed animals leave dung on the ground to shovel up.$(li)$(thing)Meat:$() yield and quality follow condition, from a scrap of Poor meat to Premium cuts.
